records.title: Baojun Launches KiWi Electric Vehicle
records.documentId: GM China Baojun KiWi launch EN
records.notes: Official English launch supplies the public KiWi EV identity and exact shared values for the two original configurations. The range cycle is not stated.

records.title: “未来感摩登座驾”KiWi EV携手宋茜正式上市
records.documentId: GM China Baojun KiWi launch ZH
records.notes: Official China launch names the Designer and Artist configurations and confirms the shared 40-kW motor and 305-km range.

records.title: 2023款KiWi EV上市 开启“人人都能拥有的智能驾驶”新时代
records.documentId: GM China Baojun KiWi 2023 launch ZH

records.title: 9.58万元起！宝骏云朵“史诗级”上市
records.documentId: GM China Baojun Yunduo launch ZH
records.notes: Official China launch lists the four exact Yunduo configurations and confirms five seats, BEV propulsion, a 100-kW motor and 150-km/h top speed. Trim numbers are not reinterpreted as certified range values.

records.title: Wuling Introduces Cloud EV, Medium Hatchback EV with The Future of Comfort
records.documentId: Wuling Indonesia Cloud EV introduction EN
records.notes: Official SGMW Indonesia material identifies the export sibling of Baojun Yunduo as a medium hatchback. No Indonesia-market technical value is copied into the China variants.
